mapper.sql: i.id, i.seller_id, seller.username AS seller_username, seller.display_name AS seller_display_name, i.category_id, category.name AS category_name, category.slug AS category_slug, i.title, i.description, i.image_url, i.price, i.status, i.created_at, i.updated_at

conv.id, conv.item_id, item.title AS item_title, item.description AS item_description, item.category_id AS item_category_id, category.name AS item_category_name, category.slug AS item_category_slug, item.image_url AS item_image_url, item.price AS item_price, item.status AS item_status, item.created_at AS item_created_at, item.updated_at AS item_updated_at, conv.buyer_id, buyer.username AS buyer_username, buyer.display_name AS buyer_display_name, conv.seller_id, seller.username AS seller_username, seller.display_name AS seller_display_name, last_message.id AS last_message_id, last_message.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, last_sender.username AS last_message_sender_username, last_sender.display_name AS last_message_sender_display_name, last_message.body AS last_message_body, last_message.created_at AS last_message_created_at, conv.created_at, conv.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_users (username, password_hash, display_name) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName})
INSERT INTO marketplace_sessions (token_hash, user_id, expires_at, revoked_at, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{userId}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{lastSeenAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, slug, sort_order, created_at FROM marketplace_categories ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT FROM marketplace_items i JOIN marketplace_users seller ON seller.id = i.seller_id JOIN marketplace_categories category ON category.id = i.category_id WHERE i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_items (seller_id, category_id, title, description, image_url, price, status) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{price}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_items SET status = 'DELISTED' WHERE id = #{id} AND seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status = 'LISTED'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketplace_conversations conv JOIN marketplace_items item ON item.id = conv.item_id JOIN marketplace_categories category ON category.id = item.category_id JOIN marketplace_users buyer ON buyer.id = conv.buyer_id JOIN marketplace_users seller ON seller.id = conv.seller_id LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages last_message ON last_message.id = ( SELECT MAX(m.id) FROM marketplace_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = conv.id ) LEFT JOIN marketplace_users last_sender ON last_sender.id = last_message.sender_id WHERE conv.item_id = #{itemId} AND conv.buyer_id = #{buyerId}

SELECT FROM marketplace_conversations conv JOIN marketplace_items item ON item.id = conv.item_id JOIN marketplace_categories category ON category.id = item.category_id JOIN marketplace_users buyer ON buyer.id = conv.buyer_id JOIN marketplace_users seller ON seller.id = conv.seller_id LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages last_message ON last_message.id = ( SELECT MAX(m.id) FROM marketplace_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = conv.id ) LEFT JOIN marketplace_users last_sender ON last_sender.id = last_message.sender_id WHERE conv.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_conversations (item_id, buyer_id, seller_id) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketplace_conversations conv JOIN marketplace_items item ON item.id = conv.item_id JOIN marketplace_categories category ON category.id = item.category_id JOIN marketplace_users buyer ON buyer.id = conv.buyer_id JOIN marketplace_users seller ON seller.id = conv.seller_id LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages last_message ON last_message.id = ( SELECT MAX(m.id) FROM marketplace_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = conv.id ) LEFT JOIN marketplace_users last_sender ON last_sender.id = last_message.sender_id WHERE conv.buyer_id = #{userId} OR conv.seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message.created_at, conv.updated_at) DESC, conv.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_messages (conversation_id, sender_id, body, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{body}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_conversations SET updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
